NUCS.description: Named User Coordinate System (NUCS). Each entry defines a local coordinate system by its origin point and the direction vectors of its local X and Y axes.

NAME.description: UCS name. A user-defined label identifying this named coordinate system.

ORG_ITEM.description: Origin O(X, Y, Z): the coordinates of the UCS origin in the global coordinate system.

VX_ITEM.description: Local X-axis direction vector V(XX, XY, XZ): components defining the orientation of the UCS local X axis in the global coordinate system.

VY_ITEM.description: Local Y-axis direction vector V(YX, YY, YZ): components defining the orientation of the UCS local Y axis in the global coordinate system.
